note: AI visual concepts based on the default 3D layouts and user-supplied photographs. They do not establish exact geometry, fit or load capacity. Original photographs are not published.

plans.label: A · 40 cm
plans.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: photorealistic visual concept for a garage storage plan, landscape photograph.
Primary request: Turn the 3D garage rendering in Image 1 into a clean but realistic photograph of this same family's actual narrow timber garage, WITHOUT a car.
Input images: Image 1 is the authoritative NEW layout and entrance-camera reference: use only the 3D scene in its left panel and completely discard the surrounding website UI, toolbar and text. Image 2 (IMG_0753) is an appearance reference for the real exposed-stud left wall, timber ledges, diagonal braces, actual green/black soft gear and loft edge. Image 3 (IMG_0755) shows the actual ladder, one black snow racer, folded chairs, ski shelf and folded white table. Image 4 (IMG_0759) shows the real equipment categories and ordinary garage materials. Image 5 (IMG_0762) shows the real timber loft edge and sloping roof. Images 2–5 are references for appearance and belongings, NOT instructions to restore the old clutter or its old furniture layout.
Geometry and layout invariants: preserve the proportions, room depth, wall positions, rear shelving arrangement and camera perspective of Image 1. This is a narrow 2.83 m wide by 6.10 m long garage; do not make it wider, taller or grander. Rear storage has two adjustable shelf bays with mixed small and large openings, including a large flexible opening, and ONE separate upright rattkjelke slot at rear right with shelves above. Preserve the left wall's recessed compartments, existing timber ledges and diagonal bracing, with flush shallow inserts and a few modest wire baskets high up (about 15 cm projection, 1.90 m clear below). Keep the left charger/cable zone clear. Preserve the right high ski shelf and shallow wall places for the aluminium folded stepladder, two folded chairs, white folded table and long tools. Preserve the timber loft over the front part of the garage and the taller sloping roof space toward the rear; make the physical wood opaque, never transparent glass.
Belongings: use a restrained, varied selection of the family's photographed gear: some folded or partly compressed green/black backpacks and soft sports bags, ski boots, skates, a rolled fabric bundle, skis, small maintenance supplies, and the ONE black snow racer. Place these in the proposed shelving and wall positions from Image 1. Backpacks have normal real-world proportions and may lie down; do not fill giant dedicated bays with repeated oversized packs. Leave some shelf capacity free. No assumed storage boxes, plastic tubs or cardboard boxes.
Style: a believable, tidy, used Norwegian family garage photographed with an ordinary wide-angle lens at the entrance. Real knotty honey-coloured pine boards and framing, visible fixings, slightly scuffed concrete floor, natural fabric creases, realistic worn sports equipment, soft daylight from the entrance and practical ceiling lighting. Clean and organized, with the character of the original garage retained.
Output: one single full-bleed landscape photorealistic image. No car, people, text, UI, labels, watermarks, diagram lines, glass walls, luxury renovation, invented windows, cabinetry or extra rooms.
Variant: Plan A: rear lower and upper shelves are 40 cm deep. Keep the larger open floor area and the additional left-wall rear bay visible, exactly as the rendering.
Snow-racer placement clarification: the OLD photograph has a sled hanging on the right wall. That location is retired. The NEW plan has exactly ONE black rattkjelke, ONLY inside the rear-right tall shelf slot. The right SIDE wall contains the ladder, folded chairs and folded white table, and NO sled. Never duplicate the snow racer.
plans.refinement: Edit target: Image 1 is the photorealistic garage concept. Make ONE targeted correction while preserving its camera, timber, lighting, shelving arrangement and depth, loft, floor and all other objects exactly. Remove the EXTRA black snow racer on the RIGHT SIDE wall, currently overlapping the folded-chair area beside the aluminium ladder: remove that extra sled body, its steering wheel and runners. Fill its area naturally with the same timber wall. Keep the TWO folded chairs, the white folded table, the aluminium ladder and skis. Keep the ONE correct black rattkjelke already inside the REAR-RIGHT tall shelf slot. Finished scene: exactly ONE snow racer in that rear slot, none on the side wall. Image 2 is the 3D reference confirming the intended placement. No other redesign, no car, no people, no text.
